Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Instagram Teen Accounts in APAC Will Be Inspired by 13+ Movie Ratings Criteria and Parent Feedback.

Decision cutoff: 2026-05-08T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Instagram Teen Accounts in APAC Will Be Inspired by 13+ Movie Ratings Criteria and Parent Feedback. Published date: 2026-05-08. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/05/apac-movie-ratings-inspired-teen-accounts.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Today, we’re announcing that we’re rolling out the revamped version of Instagram Teen Accounts across Asia Pacific Instagram Teen Accounts are now inspired by 13+ movie ratings criteria and parent feedback, so our goal is that teens see content on Instagram that’s similar to what they’d see in an age-appropriate movie by default. Teens under 18 will be automatically placed into an updated 13+ setting, and they won’t be able to opt out without a parent’s permission. This follows the initial launch of these new content settings, which rolled out to Instagram Teen Accounts in the UK, US, Australia, and Canada in October 2025. Updating Our Content Policies for Teens, Inspired by Movie Ratings Criteria and Parent Feedback AI: We’ve also updated our AI experiences for teens, inspired by 13+ movie ratings criteria and parent feedback, meaning AIs should not give age-inappropriate responses that would feel out of place in a movie rated for ages 13+.
